title: Sivakumarin Sabadham
desc: A man belongs to a weaver's family and strives to overcome multiple challenges in order to make his dreams come true of setting up a textile company.

title: Bruce Lee 2 the Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Thandatti
desc: Subramani, almost retired, goes on a hunt to find her missing grandmother. However, the search creates more trouble for Subramani than she expected.

title: Katamarayudu

desc: Bullet Raja is killed by Babu, a goon, because both love the same girl. Bullet fights with the god of death and is sent back into the body of Ravindra, a minister who was killed by his own associates.

desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

desc: A freak accident transports depressed Jeeva to a utopian alternate reality. He finds purpose in this ideal life, but fate intervenes, pulling him back to his original world.

desc: Accused of his wife's murder in an alleged honor killing, Rudra Prabhakaran is jailed. Subsequently, he descends into a dark path of vengeance after posting bail.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Gandhipuram
desc: Afraid of his disapproving father, a boy decides to elope with the girl he loves. Afraid of a greater wrath from his father, the boy's brother tries to convince them to wait.

title: NGk
desc: Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

title: Trigger

title: Eleven

title: Mandela

title: Pulimurugan

title: Bharath Ennum Naan
